context: The player has been spotted by Barton, one of the bandits in the area, who loudly alerts his comrades. Barton is shouting for the others inside the room to arm themselves and take up positions, signaling that an attack or ambush is imminent. This exchange fits the same guard/ambush template used elsewhere (cultists, Flaming Fist, Zhent agents), so the player may have only a brief moment to parley, bluff, or otherwise react before violence starts. The line "Blades out!" is the audible cue that combat readiness has been called.
